acceptance_criteria.criterion: Trusted v1/v2 contract selection and downgrade prevention
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Candidate contract is independently classified; v1 downgrade and receipt relabel adversarial tests committed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Isolated candidate execution and fail-closed receipt verification
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Candidate scenarios execute in isolated workers; receipt version, digest, exact-head and trusted harness identity are validated.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Preserve legacy v1 terminality, bounded collector recovery and idempotence
acceptance_criteria.evidence: v1 behavioral grace-boundary, dispatch-budget and active-collector-ceiling probes committed; Copilot finding addressed at 11cea57.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Preserve v2 publisher and receipt provenance rules
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Trusted publisher fixture uses real governance workflow; v2 publisher and receipt identity checks retained.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Deterministic regression and repository governance gates
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 79 passed and 8 skipped on previous full replay suite; current post-fix full suite must be independently checked; pre-push guards passed at 11cea57.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Owner-controlled rollout without bypass or merge
acceptance_criteria.evidence: PR remains Draft, no merge performed, no security gate disabled.
